title: apply_delivery_failure's mark_awaiting_correction `_ ->` arm still swallows DB errors (the N11 pattern one branch over)
detail: The r4→r5 delta restructured this exact block and fixed the same pattern in exhaust_row (N11: "a DB error is NOT a stand-down"), but this `_ ->` arm still folds a pog.Error into the 0-row stand-down: a persistent DB failure silently prevents the awaiting_correction transition — the sweep keeps inviting the failed contact and no Sentry capture fires.
recommended_fix: Split the arm: Ok(pog.Returned(_, [])) -> Nil; Error(err) -> capture(..., "ReferenceWebhookMarkAwaitingFailed", ...), mirroring exhaust_row's N11 fix.
